function: Joint prediction of antenna positions and the transmit beamforming weights of a movable-antenna array, maximizing the minimum multicast beamforming gain over users. pp. 1-3
system: BS multicast to K = 3 single fixed-antenna users; movable-antenna array N = 8, D = 10λ, d = 0.5λ; no RIS; band not stated. pp. 2, 4
method: Three feedforward modules (feature extractor, APV optimizer, AWV optimizer) trained jointly; unsupervised, loss is the minimum beamforming gain, stochastic gradient ascent. pp. 2-3
data_channel: Synthetic: user steering angles drawn uniformly over [0, π); 10^7 training and 3×10^6 test samples; steering-vector model; no 3GPP or measured data. pp. 2, 4
test_conditions: Training and testing share one random-angle distribution, default N = 8, K = 3; Figs. 3-4 vary N and K with no stated model reuse. p. 4
baselines: Non-learned: alternating SCA and SDR optimization (Baseline I), SDR with evenly spaced antennas (II), random positions and weights (III). No learned baseline. p. 4
metrics: Minimum beamforming gain versus N and versus K; beam patterns; PDFs of optimized antenna positions. pp. 4-5
complexity: Order of complexity: proposed O(N^2) after offline training; baseline I O((N^3 + (N^2+K)^3.5)Niter), II O((N^2+K)^3.5), III O(N). p. 5
q1_support: p. 4: "are generated randomly according to the uniform distribution over [0, π)"; the channel is a custom steering-vector model (p. 2), and no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "The proposed DL model is trained using" 10^7 samples of the same angle distribution as the test samples; Figs. 3-4 vary N and K, but no reuse of a trained model, fine-tuning, or unseen scenario is stated.
q3_support: p. 4: "Baseline Scheme III: The APV x and AWV w are randomly determined"; baselines I to III are non-learned, and p. 1 says the work is "the first to exploit the DL technique for the beamforming design with MA array".
q4_support: p. 5: "the proposed DL model requires a low computational complexity of O(N 2 )", with the orders of the three baselines given in the same paragraph.
q5_support: p. 4: "are generated randomly according to the uniform distribution over [0, π)"; the data are synthetic, and no code link, DOI, or public dataset is given.
notes: Counted as beamforming (area 3): the learned output is the BS beamformer (AWV) together with the movable-antenna positions, as an array configuration rather than antenna hardware design. The paper claims to be the first DL work on MA beamforming (p. 1). Figs. 3 to 6 were also read on the page images.
